scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check
scripts.build: npm run build:electron && ng build receiptmatch
scripts.build:electron: tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && webpack --fail-on-warnings && ng build receiptmatch-preview
scripts.pack:win: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-local-ocr-runtimes.mjs win32 && electron-builder --win --x64 --dir --publish never
scripts.pack:linux: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-local-ocr-runtimes.mjs linux && electron-builder --linux --x64 --dir --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-local-ocr-runtimes.mjs win32 && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-local-ocr-runtimes.mjs linux && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb --x64 --publish never
scripts.start: npm run build:electron && wait-on --reverse --timeout 1000 tcp:127.0.0.1:4310 && concurrently -k --success first "cross-env CI=1 PORT=4310 ng serve receiptmatch --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4310 --hmr" "wait-on --timeout 60000 http-get://127.0.0.1:4310/ && cross-env ELECTRON_START_URL=http://127.0.0.1:4310/ electron ."
scripts.start:dist: npm run build && cross-env ELECTRON_START_URL= electron .
scripts.test:development: tsc -p tsconfig.playwright.json && npm run build && playwright test --config tests/development/playwright.config.ts
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:electron
